_comment: How actors look (client only; the core never reads this). A look is a set of layers, one sprite sheet each; single-sheet monsters use one 'body' layer. layerOrder = drawing order per facing (art compass: map +x = E), from back to front; layers it does not name are drawn last. looks.player is the bare character; gear adds or replaces layers by item base id (equipped items, slot by slot); slotLayers limits what an item may draw from each equipment slot. mirroredLayers: the art has no left-hand weapons, so a weapon in the off hand draws its main-hand art seen in a mirror (sheet id 'mirror:<sheet>': the mirrored facing, flipped); on the off hand's swing the whole figure is drawn mirrored with the weapons swapped, so the left arm is the one that strikes. looks.<monster type id> = that monster (bosses use their baseType); a type without a look, or whose sheets are missing, is drawn as a magenta checkerboard with '?'. attack = animation of the attack (swing | shoot | cast). fallbacks = animation to use when a sheet lacks one (packs often have no hit or block). Size on screen: every look is scaled so the figure standing is sizes.heroHeightPx × its 'height' tall (94 px ≈ the hero's share of the screen in Diablo 2 at 800×600; height is relative to the hero: wolves and the boar are lower but not tiny), then × the rank's sizeMult. strideTiles = tiles walked per run cycle (feet do not slide at any speed). corpseSeconds = how long a dead monster stays on the floor (the last 1.5 s it fades). hitFlash = brightness added while in hit recovery or stunned. ART IS NOT IN THE REPOSITORY: when the game opens it checks every sheet and downloads the missing ones into the per-user folder (<user data>/art/sprites; AETHELGARD_ART_DIR overrides); by hand: python -m aethelgard.tools.fetch_art. import = settings of that tool. sources: one per sheet-id prefix. kind 'repo' = files fetched one by one from base (pinned commit): folders maps the id to the folder of its animation file, imageRoot = what the animation's image= is relative to. kind 'archive' = a pack: url, or urls when it comes in several files (archives are opened, loose PNGs kept as they are); sheets maps the rest of the id to globs on file names, tried in order (the first that matches wins): animation (Flare .txt, compressed or grid format) and image (omit = the image the animation names; a glob picks a recolor); exclude = names never used for that sheet. scale: resolution the frames are stored at (the art is then scaled to its target height when drawn; 0.6 keeps it sharp). version: bump it when the import changes; sheets built by an older one are rebuilt when the game opens. colors = palette size of the PNGs, 0 = full color. Credits and license of each source are written next to its sheets (ATTRIBUTION.md) and listed in docs/licencas_assets.csv.
